'''Morthul''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individual who was possessed by the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] after coming across an amulet containing the spirit. He savagely beat a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]], much to his friends' surprise.
